question: Reinhard has a massive number of blessings, but is there a limit to the number of blessings, and are there any blessings that there can't be two of? (Aside from the Blessing of Wind Avoidance)
answer: There are several blessings that there can only be one of at a time. The "Blessing of the Master Swordsman" and such are that way. There's no upper limit to the number of blessings that Reinhard can have. Blessings are normally one per person, so the idea of establishing an upper limit never occurred.
